notes: Scan 109 has 22 principal horizontal baselines, counting the display (153). The two marginal notes and pencil number are inventoried separately. No OCR, external source or other page was consulted.

The main text asserts that D_J is smooth and its canonical map to X is a local immersion of codimension d, then describes the one-element and two-element cases. These are manuscript assertions, not verified results in this first-reader task.
The insertion actually writes I twice in d(I)=0 i.e. I. The surrounding argument otherwise uses J, but this is not corrected: the letterforms are explicit.

The reconstruction paragraph identifies a principal S_d-torsor D!d and an ordered-chain model I(d). The oblique note qualifies the visibility of the S_d operations in that description and introduces K_d with one least element of codimension d and d elements of codimension 1. This gives context for reading the note but supplies no independent proof.

The nested C doubts omitted from the supplied mark-ID list were all examined: the opening cancelled word, cancelled retrouver, the two cancelled superscripts, and cancelled élément. They remain doubtful because not every underlying letter or stroke is exposed.

The superscript on D!d has a live upright and separate point, supporting an exclamation mark rather than a prime. The additional dark mark above it is retained as a doubtful cancelled tilde in both main and marginal occurrences.

Fifteen first-pass crops were created and all fifteen were viewed. The separate shallow-sloping second margin was treated as a different note from the steep first one; the pencil number has its own tight crop.

Second-reading boxes for the oblique note necessarily overlap fragments of horizontal body writing. Their reading fields give the complete targeted note; the horizontal text is separately covered by B11–B15.

Targeted combinatorial check (MC109-01): a finite chain with one vertex at each codimension has only the identity order automorphism; for d>1 the alternative poset described in the margin permits S_d by permuting its d codimension-1 elements. This explains the stated concern about displaying the action, but does not prove the geometric presentation or change the written action target.

check_events.outcome: Proved the automorphism statements directly from the unique successive vertices of the chain and the free permutation of the star leaves; scope is the finite posets described on scan 109, d>1. No geometric representability proof claimed.
